throughline.zh: 台灣及東南亞電子製造鏈本週新增客戶驗收的光通訊產品、越南配電設備廠投產進度與各地製造業調查，同時保留晶片、記憶體和政策資料的原始時點。
throughline.en: This week's Taiwan and Southeast Asian coverage includes qualified optical products, Vietnam power-equipment production and manufacturing surveys, alongside dated chip, memory and policy disclosures.

title.zh: 光通訊、AI 晶片及網路互連
title.en: Optical interconnects, AI chips and networking

summary.zh: 聯發科對 AI ASIC 市占提出 2027 年預估，毅嘉 11 月 2 日則證實馬來西亞居林光通訊產品通過客戶驗證並量產。TrendForce 同日提出 2027 年全球網路互連 2,798 億美元市場預測；產品驗收、公司指引與研究估計各自獨立。
summary.en: MediaTek's 2027 ASIC outlook is a forecast, while IChia confirmed qualified optical production in Kulim on November 2. TrendForce projected US$279.8B in global interconnect revenue for 2027, distinct from supplier acceptance and booked sales.

title.zh: 資料中心供電、液冷與越南配電產線
title.en: Data-center power, liquid cooling and Vietnam switchgear

summary.zh: 鴻海亞灣超算 10 月 31 日說明資料中心採用液冷的技術方向，但未公告新增 MW。宏于 11 月 2 日表示越南興安新廠第三季已投產，預製型變電站及滿載產能數字仍有後續試產與驗收節點。
summary.en: Visionbay described liquid cooling in recent data-center deployments without new energized MW. Horng Yu said its Hung Yen power-equipment factory began production in Q3, with prefabricated substations and full-utilization capacity still subject to later milestones.

title.zh: 台灣與東南亞製造調查及半導體貿易
title.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asian manufacturing surveys and chip trade

summary.zh: 南韓 11 月 1 日公布對東協出口及半導體貿易數字；11 月 2 日台灣、馬來西亞與越南的製造業 PMI 新值顯示營運仍在擴張區間，但部分電子零組件、原料價格及交貨條件有壓力。PMI 屬調查指數，不能與出口金額直接比較。
summary.en: South Korea released ASEAN and chip trade data on November 1. Manufacturing PMIs published November 2 show expansion in Taiwan, Malaysia and Vietnam alongside input-cost and delivery constraints; diffusion indices are distinct from trade-value growth.

title.zh: 記憶體成本、設備交期與 PC 晶片營運
title.en: Memory costs, equipment lead times and PC-chip results

summary.zh: 台灣手機品牌 11 月 1 日受訪談記憶體成本及機型策略，旺宏董事長 11 月 2 日指出記憶體設備交期拉長、價格上升。義隆電同日公布第三季營收季減 30.7%，並將部分整機出貨下滑歸因於零件供應不均；不同公司的原因與數據不能直接混算。
summary.en: Taiwan smartphone vendors discussed memory costs on November 1; Macronix management cited longer equipment lead times and higher prices on November 2. Elan reported a 30.7% sequential fall in Q3 revenue and pointed to uneven PC component supply, with different company metrics kept separate.

title.zh: 研發、設備投資與零組件追溯政策
title.en: R&D, equipment investment and component traceability

summary.zh: 內政部公布無人機晶片來源清查，主計總處揭露第三季半導體設備進口與 GDP 概估，國科會另提供 2025 年研發經費歷史統計。日工商會對材料、精密設備及綠電的意見屬產業團體觀點，各項政策、統計與投資時間均有明確區別。
summary.en: The Interior Ministry reviewed drone component origins; Taiwan reported Q3 equipment imports and GDP estimates, while NSTC disclosed historical 2025 R&D spending. Japan's chamber also discussed materials, tools and renewable power, with policy positions and historical statistics distinguished.
